The new modular structure under /app/backend/app/ has been created with properly organized routers for auth, cases, evidence, sos, analytics, attorneys, and ai_chat.

critical_code_review_comments: The new modular structure is well-organized with proper separation of concerns
All routers properly import from shared modules (db, security, schemas)
WebSocket manager is properly shared across routers
Config module centralizes environment variables and feature flags
Note: The new modular app (main.py) is NOT yet active - server.py is still running
seed_data_creation: Test user created during registration test, test cases created during CRUD tests (prefixed with TEST_)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend refactoring verification complete. The original server.py (~6000 lines) is still running and serving all requests. A new modular structure has been created under /app/backend/app/ with: main.py (entry point), routers/ (auth, cases, evidence, sos, analytics, attorneys, ai_chat, health), core/ (config, security), db/ (database), models/ (schemas), services/ (websocket, ai_service). To switch to the new modular app, update supervisor config to point to app.main:app instead of server:app. All 27 endpoint tests pass.
